summary: Read one positive integer. Decide whether some integer multiplies by itself to produce it. Write true if such an integer exists, and write false otherwise. Do not call a square-root function supplied by the language, and do not use a floating-point library to take a root. Use only integer multiplication, division, or comparison to decide.
notes: The left column is this sample's input text and the right column is the text the program should print. Comparison ignores trailing newlines.
